edit.description: the shared capture, whose two legs both hold the child's stderr and hand back its stdout alone, and the result shape that states what one run left behind
the two refusals over a run it could not read, each quoting stdout for a cause that is never on it
the refusal over stdout that answers no requested name, the other reader of the same capture
both runners' refusal cases, over a real child that writes its cause to stderr

summary: a shipped runner's refusal over a run it could not read names what the child wrote to stderr, the cause the shared capture holds and drops

per.section: A fact the engine holds is reported, never rediscovered

acceptance: every refusal a shipped runner raises over output it could not read names what the child wrote to stderr beside what it wrote to stdout, so the cause of a base run's refusal outlives the gate boundary that reclaims the tree the message names
tests: a captured run hands back the stderr its child wrote beside its stdout
a vitest run that produced no report refuses naming what its child wrote to stderr
a script runner refusing an unreadable report names what its child wrote to stderr
notes: Measured this tick: vitest whose filters collect nothing exits 1, writes its explanation to stderr and nothing to stdout, so readRun's refusal prints an empty `Last output`. execFileWithShimRetry returns {stdout, stderr}; captureRun keeps stdout alone on both legs. The base tree the message names is removed when the gate unwinds (runGate), so nobody can re-run it. detailOf (harness/exec.ts) reads stderr first — the sync half of one capture already answers this.

interface.changes: nothing a consumer calls: `CapturedRun` is internal to the package's two shipped runners, and both operations' signatures stand
interface.hides: that a refusal over unreadable output was the whole account of a failure whose cause the capture had already decoded and dropped
interface.rejected: letting the child's stderr through to the operator's terminal — a gate's child output is captured by the engine, and the sync half of this capture already pipes stderr for exactly that reason
